about: Mutants of the limiter's generated RPC client, held to the limits.Limiter laws under the named contexts of loopback/tests.ergo (HUB-CLIENT-UNFED). Killers are the examples suite (examples:limiter). A hub Client that drops a field is refuted by the hub's own laws (ClientIsCall), so it has no row here.

mutants.name: hcu-rpc-drops-retry-after
mutants.rule: The RPC Client is held to the limits.Limiter laws under overMemory (loopback/tests.ergo): a Client that drops Limited's RetryAfterMs on its way back is refuted by RetryAfterIsExact.
